## ROLEPLAY RULE 8. Listen to your team leader and don't abandon your role.
Do not join the round as a role that you don’t intend to play. If you leave the game, use cryosleep if possible. Do not enable antagonist roles that you don’t intend to play. Abandoning a role includes not completing tasks that the role is expected to do, in addition to things like leaving the game, suiciding or ghosting when the round starts.
"Antag rolling" refers to a player abandoning their role if they do not get an antagonist role, and is prohibited.
Unless you request a job change, stick to your job and don’t perform other people’s jobs, unless the station is understaffed or there is a significant threat to you otherwise or antagonistic advantage in doing so. This also prohibits "validhunting", which refers to hunting down antagonists without justifiable reason, such as it being part of your job.
The captain leads all departments and other members of command, who lead members of their department. Team antagonists often has a team leader, such as nuclear operative commanders or head revolutionaries. You are not required to perfectly follow orders given to you by your leaders, but you should generally allow them to lead and not interfere with their ability to. You can question orders, and ignore unreasonable orders, such as ones that result in your death (unless you’re an antagonist with an objective that requires your death.)
